description: React component 'SupabaseHealth' performs a lightweight health check against a Supabase backend by verifying environment variables, attempting to retrieve an auth session, and querying a 'profiles' table. It displays a status badge indicating connectivity status, mainly intended for development or debugging purposes.

methods.name: SupabaseHealth
methods.description: React functional component that displays the health status of the Supabase connection, performing checks on mount.
